tools.name: read_snapshot_provenance
tools.description: Read snapshot dates, pinned upstream commit, source hashes, license, counts and evidence limitations. Not a live monitor or independent verification.

tools.name: search_document_metadata
tools.description: Find bounded public document metadata by document-ID prefix, dataset or source classification. No person search or removed-text passages. Preserve automated/triage labels and false-positive states.

tools.name: read_document_metadata
tools.description: Read one public source document ID, source-reported change counts, classifications and snapshot provenance. No names, passages, private identifiers or invented verification.
